topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: It’s a sunny morning when my neighbor knocks on my door, her eyes bright and cheeks flushed with the kind of color that only comes from being under the open sky too long. She asks, with a hopeful smile, if she could use a corner of my yard for a garden. The idea is as fresh and appealing as the scent of soil after rain. I can already imagine the shared bounty of tomatoes and herbs, the laughter we’ll exchange over a fence while we water our plants. It’s a pleasant surprise, a lovely invitation to grow something more than just friendship. I nod eagerly, gesturing toward the sunlit patch she’s eyeing, and we start planning right there, our enthusiasm bubbling over.
